tools.name: request_signup
tools.title: Request Compabase Signup
tools.description: Start Compabase account setup for an email. Sends a magic link. After the user clicks it, check_signup with the returned setup_id reports status ready and returns the MCP key automatically. No key has to be generated in the portal. No auth required.

email.description: User email to create or sign in to a Compabase account.

client.description: AI client, used to label the generated MCP key.

tools.name: check_signup
tools.title: Check Compabase Signup Status
tools.description: Poll a request_signup session. When the user has confirmed email, returns mcp_key once and cursor_mcp_json to write to MCP config. Call every 3 seconds until status is ready, expired, or already_delivered. No auth required.

client.description: Optional client hint for the key name.

tools.name: list_plans

tools.description: List Compabase billing plans and limits. No auth required. After sign-up, use upgrade_plan to get a Stripe Checkout URL.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search Polish Companies
tools.description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website) — small enough for MCP clients. `fields=contacts_only` is name/NIP/KRS/city/email/phone/website only. `fields=full` returns every company_search column plus contacts and may exceed client size limits. Use for rankings, sector filters, city/county/region browsing, name search, or NIP/KRS lookup. When a PKD is mostly JDG, a sparse result includes a `hint` (full CEIDG is in the database; listing is RODO-gated). For a handful of emails or phones, fields=contacts_only here is enough; export_companies is meant for bulk files.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive). Matches display name and full KRS name; legal-form suffixes like 'sp. z o.o.' are ignored.

krs.description: KRS registry number (10 digits, zero-padded, e.g. '0000028860').

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, no dashes).

city.description: City name — KRS records use uppercase, e.g. 'WARSZAWA', 'POZNAŃ'.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '46.90.Z' or '46'.

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

legal_form.description: Legal form fragment, e.g. 'spółka z o.o.' or 'akcyjna'.

currency.description: Currency for monetary filters. Default: pln.

profit_operating_min.description: Minimum operating profit (PLN). Negative allowed. Omit if unused.

profit_operating_max.description: Maximum operating profit (PLN). Omit if unused.

ownership_structure.description: Ownership: pl_independent = Polish company controlled by individuals; pl_group = part of a Polish group (a Polish company holds ≥50%); foreign_group = foreign shareholders ≥50% or foreign parent (GLEIF / CRBR).

family_business.description: true = family business (people with the same surname hold ≥50%).

naics.description: Detailed industry: NAICS 6-digit codes, comma-separated (any of them), e.g. '541511,541512'. AI classification of what the company actually does.

service.description: Service the company offers (Compabase services dictionary, from company websites): service name in Polish/English/German, e.g. 'księgowość', 'heat pumps', or slugs from compabase.com/services, comma-separated (any of them).

niche.description: Detailed industry in words (Polish), matched against the company's niche, e.g. 'opakowania', 'software house', 'catering'.

estimated_value_min.description: Minimum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

estimated_value_max.description: Maximum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

registration_date_min.description: Earliest KRS registration date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). For newly registered companies use today's date for both registration_date_min and registration_date_max.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = closed only. Omit for all.

has_email.description: true = only companies with email on record. Matching rows include contacts.email. Omit otherwise.

has_website.description: true = only companies with website on record. Matching rows include contacts.website. Omit otherwise.

sort_by.description: Sort field (default: revenue_total). registration_date + sort_dir=desc lists the newest registrations first. revenue_growth_pct + sort_dir=desc lists the fastest-growing companies (y/y revenue growth from KRS financial statements; combine with revenue_min to skip small companies).

year.description: Filter to companies whose latest financial_period_to falls within this calendar year (e.g. 2024). Use only for sector/ranking browse — omit when looking up a company by name, KRS, or NIP.

fields.description: Response size. Default summary (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website). contacts_only: name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website. full: every company_search column plus contacts — often too large for MCP clients.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get Company Profile
tools.description: Get company registry profile and headline financials for one latest filed period (`financials.period_to` / `financial_period_to`): revenue, profit, costs, assets, estimated_value (Ohlson/RIM equity estimate), PKD, address, plus contacts when on record, full address, share capital, representation, recent KRS changes and `company_summary` (company description from the profile, language via `lang`), `logo_url`, `job_offers` (current job offers from the company career page and public job boards), `similar_companies`, `vat` (MF white list: VAT status, VAT registration date, bank accounts, removal/restoration, date Compabase checked it). All money fields in this response are that same period — there is no nested summary from a different year. NIP lookup also returns a CEIDG/JDG firm when it has a public contact email (RODO). Does NOT include balance-sheet line items (cash, receivables, inventories). For those or earlier years, use get_financials.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, dashes optional).

lang.description: Language of `company_summary` (default pl). Falls back to en, pl, de when missing.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.title: Get Full Financial Statements
tools.description: Get full financial statement metrics per fiscal period — all entity_financial_metrics columns. Includes cash_and_equivalents, inventories, receivables, liabilities, equity, cost breakdown, revenue lines. The standalone row of the latest analysed statement also has `notes` (additional information from the statement): average employment (employees_avg, employees_avg_prev), income tax, profit distribution and dividend, parent and ultimate parent, related-party transactions, shareholdings, guarantees and contingent liabilities, loans, auditor fee, revenue split. Every row has `insights`: the financial signals shown on the Compabase profile for that year and scope (plain-text sentences, e.g. negative equity, cash share of current assets), and `metric_summaries`: the sentences next to each statement line on the profile ({ revenue_total: [...], ebitda: [...], equity: [...], … }, with y/y change and structure). Both in `lang` with amounts in `currency`; [] / {} when none. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

currency.description: Currency of amounts inside `insights` and `metric_summaries` (default pln). Statement figures stay in PLN.

tools.name: get_company_people
tools.title: Get Company People & Management
tools.description: Get people associated with a company — management board, supervisory board, shareholders, proxies. Returns display names, role labels, and relationship types (management, supervisory, ownership, procuration). `connected_companies`: other companies where these people hold roles or shares (company connections from the profile). Identify by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

relationship_type.description: Filter: management, supervisory (rada nadzorcza), ownership, procuration. Omit for all.

tools.name: count_companies
tools.title: Count Polish Companies
tools.description: Count KRS companies matching given filters. Returns a single number — no company list. Does not count JDG in this tool (full CEIDG is in Compabase; listing is RODO-gated). Sparse or zero counts in JDG-dominated PKDs include a `hint`.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.title: Execute Read-Only SQL
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the Compabase database. Use when dedicated tools are not enough (aggregations, joins, custom analysis). Returns at most row_limit rows per call depending on the plan (Free 100, Pro 500, Scale 1000); if truncated is true, the full result is larger and fits better as an aggregate inside SQL (GROUP BY, COUNT, AVG, percentile_cont).

query.description: A read-only SQL SELECT or WITH…SELECT statement.

tools.name: get_company_rankings
tools.title: Get Company Sector Rankings
tools.description: Get a company's revenue rank positions within its industry (PKD), region (voivodeship), and all of Poland. Returns rows from company_financial_rankings — one row per scope (pkd_full, pkd_division, pkd_section, region, country). PKD scope keys of historical classifications are prefixed with the version: 'v2007:62.01.Z', 'v2004:50', 'v1997:74.84.B' (no prefix = PKD 2025). `benchmark`: the company compared with peers (median, quartiles, mean of revenue, profit, costs, assets) in its industry, region and city, as on the profile. Use for questions like: where does company X rank in Poland / its industry / its region, how does it compare with its industry?

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, dashes optional).

scope_type.description: Optional. Filter to a single scope. Omit to get all scopes.

tools.name: get_financial_stats
tools.title: Get Sector Financial Statistics
tools.description: Get precomputed aggregate financial statistics for a sector, region, PKD branch, or country. Returns median, p25/p75/p90, winsorized mean, mean, total, n_companies, min/max. Use for questions like: what is the median revenue / average profit / assets in industry X or region Y? median and winsor_mean are robust to outliers; mean is not. cost_wages is PLN-only.

dimension_key.description: Key for the dimension, e.g. 'PL', 'G', '46', '46.90.Z', 'mazowieckie'. Prefix match applied.

metric.description: Financial metric. Omit to return all metrics.

tools.title: Get Public Sector Contracts (CRU)
tools.description: Get contracts from Poland's Central Register of Contracts (CRU JSFP, Ministry of Finance) where the company is the contractor of a public-sector unit (ministries, municipalities, schools, hospitals) — count, total value, top public buyers and the 50 most recent contracts (date, subject, value in PLN, buyer, link). Register live since July 2026; covers contracts below tender thresholds too. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_nfz_contracts
tools.title: Get National Health Fund Contracts (NFZ)
tools.description: Get contracts between the company (as a healthcare provider) and Poland's National Health Fund (NFZ) — value of NFZ contracts in the latest year and every year since 2008, types of care (hospital, outpatient, dental, rehabilitation, pharmacy etc.) with NFZ regional branch, and the largest contracts. Amounts are annual contract values in PLN. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_group
tools.title: Get Corporate Group (GLEIF LEI register)
tools.description: Get the corporate group of a Polish company from the global LEI register (GLEIF), supplemented with foreign corporate shareholders from KRS matched to it: direct parent and ultimate parent (name, country, LEI), subsidiaries and other group companies — Polish ones with KRS number, foreign ones with country — and group size. Answers 'who owns this company', 'which concern does it belong to', 'other companies of the group in Poland and abroad'. Keyed by KRS. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

limit.description: Max group companies per list (default 50, max 200).

tools.name: get_company_nfz_queues
tools.title: Get NFZ Waiting Lists (Terminy leczenia)
tools.description: Get NFZ (National Health Fund) waiting lists of a healthcare provider — every NFZ-funded service (specialist clinics, diagnostics such as MRI/CT, procedures, rehabilitation, hospital wards) it runs a waiting list for, per location: NFZ forecast waiting time for stable and urgent cases, people waiting, average wait, address, phone, whether children are seen and accessibility. Sorted by shortest wait. Optional filters: service (e.g. 'okulist', 'rezonans') and town. Data from the NFZ 'Terminy leczenia' API; the forecast is not a booking. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

service.description: Optional filter: fragment of the service name, e.g. 'okulist', 'ortoped', 'rezonans'.

town.description: Optional filter: town or district, e.g. 'Poznań'.

tools.name: get_company_trademarks
tools.title: Get Trademarks (UPRP)
tools.description: Get Polish Patent Office (UPRP) trademarks owned or applied for by the company — mark name, application number, Nice classes, status (protected / pending / expired / refused), filing, registration and expiry dates, plus counts. Owners are matched by company name and city (UPRP does not publish NIP). Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_corporate_tax
tools.title: Get Corporate Income Tax (CIT)
tools.description: Get corporate income tax (CIT) return data published by the Polish Ministry of Finance for the largest taxpayers (revenue above EUR 50 million), tax capital groups and real estate companies — revenue, tax-deductible costs, income, loss, tax base, tax due and effective rate for each year since 2020, plus national rank by tax due. These are tax-return categories (art. 12/15 CIT Act), not accounting figures: revenue and income differ from the financial statement (use get_financials for accounting revenue and income tax). Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.title: Get Public Benefit Status (OPP, 1.5% of tax)
tools.description: Get public benefit organisation (OPP) status of a foundation or association — whether it is on the NIW list eligible for 1.5% of personal income tax, and the amounts it received from taxpayers' 1%/1.5% allocations each year since 2019 with approximate donor counts and national / regional rank. Identify by name or KRS.

tools.name: get_company_financial_documents
tools.title: Get Filed Financial Documents
tools.description: Get the list of documents the company filed to the KRS Financial Documents Repository (RDF): document kind, period and format (XML or PDF), newest first. Figures extracted from these documents are in get_financials. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_market_environment
tools.title: Get Market Environment of Company's Industry
tools.description: Get the market environment of the company's industry (NAICS classification, else PKD 2007 class): a one-sentence summary (favourable / unfavourable / mixed / stable) and up to 4 strongest, non-overlapping indicators, each with a headline, a concrete observation with figures, effect on the company (positive/negative/neutral), source and the time series. Indicators: revenue growth and net margin of comparable companies computed from KRS financial statements, demand (sales/services volume, output), prices and bankruptcies from Monitly (Eurostat, GUS), latest-month GUS retail prices of what the company or its industry sells. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP; sole proprietors (CEIDG) by NIP, matched by their main PKD class.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

lang.description: Language of summary and observations (default pl).

tools.description: Get BDO waste and packaging register data — registration number, EUP site count, activity flags, and headquarters decisions with issue and validity dates. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.description: Get road transport licences from the KREPTD register (GITD) — EU community licences (goods over / up to 3.5 t, passengers) and national road carrier permits with number, status (valid / suspended / withdrawn / expired), issue and expiry dates, issuing authority, vehicle counts, current certified copies (wypisy) and a fleet estimate. name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.title: Get Warsaw Stock Exchange Data (GPW)
tools.description: Get Warsaw Stock Exchange listing for a company — ticker, ISIN, market (GPW main / NewConnect / GlobalConnect), last close and change, market cap, shares outstanding, TTM EPS, TTM P/E (falls back to last annual filing), last quarterly results, next earnings date, dividend per share and yield. Quotes delayed ~15 minutes, in PLN. Snapshot plus a few recent daily bars — not full OHLCV history. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.title: Get EU Tenders Daily (TED)

tools.title: Get Court and Commercial Gazette (MSiG)
tools.description: Get Court and Commercial Gazette (MSiG) notices for one company. Matched by KRS or NIP (creditor calls, dissolution, mergers, liquidation).

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_sanctions
tools.title: Get sanctions and PEP screening
tools.description: Sanctions and PEP screening for one company. entries[] with kind=entity: the company itself on a sanctions list (MSWiA, EU, US, UK, World Bank), matched by KRS, NIP or REGON, with measures and legal grounds. kind=person: board members, proxies, owners and beneficial owners matched to sanctions lists (EU, UN, US, UK, MSWiA) or PEP sources (Sejm, Wikidata, boards of state-owned companies), with list_kind, confidence (confirmed = PESEL or birth date, likely = birth year; name-only matches are not published), role in the company, public positions and soe_role. Null when nothing matched. The same payload is included on get_company as sanctions.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_debt_registry
tools.title: Get National Debt Register (KRZ)
tools.description: Get KRZ insolvency / restructuring proceedings. KRS companies via company_krz; sole proprietors via CEIDG KRZ by NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_financial_supervision

tools.description: KNF register (Polish Financial Supervision Authority): licences and entries of a financial company — banks, payment / e-money institutions, investment firms, insurers, lending institutions, agents. name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

Also overdue_year when the latest statement is past its deadline and missing, and late_last_5y. Keyed by KRS; null when the company has never filed.

Keyed by KRS; null when nothing is disclosed.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_real_estate
tools.title: Get Company Real Estate
tools.description: Company real estate from the latest financial statement (period ending 2025+): land incl. perpetual usufruct, buildings and premises, investment property (book values in PLN/EUR/USD) plus property locations named as mortgage collateral (address, land-register KW numbers, creditor). Keyed by KRS; null when the balance sheet shows no real estate (micro and small entities have no such breakdown).

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tools.name: get_company_beneficiaries
tools.title: Get Ultimate Beneficial Owners (CRBR)

krs.description: KRS registry number (required path for CRBR).

nip.description: NIP — used to resolve KRS when needed.

tools.name: get_company_articles
tools.title: Get Articles of Association
tools.description: Get full text of the company's articles of association or statute (umowa spółki / statut) from RAR (Repozytorium Akt Rejestrowych). Use when the user asks about: share transfer consent, preemption rights, non-compete clauses, company duration, voting rights, special share classes, representation rules from the deed, or any clause in the founding document. Returns doc metadata + full extracted text. KRS companies only.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

nip.description: NIP — used to resolve KRS when needed.

doc_id.description: Optional: specific rar_doc_id. Omit for the latest articles / statute.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get Account Usage & Quota
tools.description: Get current billing period usage and remaining quota — mcp_queries, api_requests, export_companies, ask_ai_credits, watchlist_companies. Includes limits and reset date.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get Current Subscription Plan
tools.description: Get the user's active billing plan details — plan name, price, status, limits, prepaid credit balance, and billing period reset date.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.title: List Watchlist Companies
tools.description: List companies on the user's watchlist with company data (name, KRS, NIP, revenue, city). Supports pagination via limit/offset.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.title: Add Company to Watchlist
tools.description: Add a company to the user's watchlist. Identify by KRS (10-digit) or NIP (10-digit). Supports both KRS companies and CEIDG sole proprietorships (via NIP).

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits). Used for CEIDG if no KRS match.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.title: Remove Company from Watchlist
tools.description: Remove a company from the user's watchlist. Identify by KRS or NIP.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.title: List REST API Keys
tools.description: List all active REST API keys (cb_…) for the user's account. Returns id, name, key_prefix, created_at, last_used_at.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.title: Create REST API Key
tools.description: Create a new REST API key (cb_…). The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key (max 100 chars).

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.title: Revoke REST API Key
tools.description: Revoke (deactivate) a REST API key by its ID. The key stops working immediately.

key_id.description: UUID of the API key to revoke (from list_api_keys).

tools.name: list_mcp_keys
tools.title: List MCP Keys
tools.description: List all active MCP keys (mcpk_…) for the user's account. Returns id, name, key_prefix, created_at, last_used_at.

tools.name: create_mcp_key
tools.title: Create MCP Key
tools.description: Create a new MCP key (mcpk_…). The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key (max 100 chars).

tools.name: delete_mcp_key
tools.title: Revoke MCP Key
tools.description: Revoke (deactivate) an MCP key by its ID. Cannot revoke the key currently in use. The key stops working immediately.

key_id.description: UUID of the MCP key to revoke (from list_mcp_keys).

tools.name: export_companies
tools.title: Export Companies to CSV
tools.description: Bulk file export of companies matching filters (CSV / XLSX / JSON). Up to 500 rows per call. Default `fields=contacts_only`: name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website — small enough to use in-chat. `fields=summary` adds location, PKD, latest revenue/profit. `fields=full` is the complete dump (change history, rankings, people, enrichments, CSV twins) and often exceeds MCP client limits. Consumes export quota only after the file is built successfully. A short list of emails is also available directly from search_companies with fields=contacts_only.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive).

krs.description: KRS registry number (exports that one company).

county.description: County / powiat (lowercase). Same filter as search_companies / count_companies.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '80.10', '80.10.Z', or '80' (same prefix matching as search_companies).

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

format.description: Export format (default: csv). Column set follows `fields` (contacts_only by default).

fields.description: Payload size. Default contacts_only (name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website). summary adds county/region, PKD, latest revenue/profit. full is the complete profile dump — often too large for MCP clients; use only when asked for the full file.

tools.name: upgrade_plan
tools.title: Upgrade Subscription Plan
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a plan upgrade. Shows current plan and available upgrades. Pass plan_id ('pro' or 'scale') to get a checkout_url on checkout.stripe.com — the user pays there in the browser. The checkout_url is the direct payment page for the selected plan.

plan_id.description: Target plan ID. Required to create a Stripe Checkout URL.

locale.description: UI locale for the success/cancel return URLs (default en).

currency.description: Checkout currency. Defaults from locale (pl → PLN, otherwise USD).

tools.name: set_webhook_url
tools.title: Configure Webhook URL
tools.description: Configure, view, or remove webhook for watchlist event notifications. Events (default: all): watchlist.company_changed, watchlist.board_changed, watchlist.ownership_changed, watchlist.status_changed, watchlist.company_removed_from_registry, watchlist.financials_updated, watchlist.filing_overdue, watchlist.insolvency, watchlist.court_gazette, watchlist.secured_liabilities, watchlist.sanctions, watchlist.public_tenders, watchlist.public_aid, watchlist.licenses, watchlist.nfz, watchlist.trademarks, watchlist.job_offers.

action.description: Action: 'get' to view config, 'set' to configure, 'delete' to remove.

url.description: HTTPS webhook endpoint URL (required for action=set).

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all available events.

tools.name: get_byok_keys
tools.title: Get Bring-Your-Own-Key Providers
tools.description: List configured Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) provider keys status. Shows which providers (openai, claude, gemini) have keys configured, with prefix and last-used date. Never returns the actual key.

tools.name: set_byok_key
tools.title: Set Bring-Your-Own-Key Provider
tools.description: Add or update a BYOK provider API key. Key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Requires paid plan (Pro+). Providers: openai (sk-…), claude (sk-ant-…), gemini (AIza… or AQ.…).

api_key.description: Raw API key for the provider.

tools.name: delete_byok_key
tools.title: Remove Bring-Your-Own-Key Provider
tools.description: Remove a configured BYOK provider key. After removal, the platform falls back to its own model access.

tools.name: add_watchlist_batch
tools.title: Batch Add Companies to Watchlist
tools.description: Add multiple companies to watchlist in one call. Provide an array of KRS/NIP identifiers (max 500). Resolves identifiers to companies, skips duplicates, respects plan limits.

identifiers.description: Array of KRS numbers (10 digits) or NIP numbers (10 digits).

tools.name: set_notification_preferences
tools.title: Set Notification Preferences
tools.description: Get or update email notification preferences for watchlist changes. When email_notifications=true, you will receive an email whenever a watched company's data changes (registry updates, new financial statements, deregistration, etc.).

email_notifications.description: Enable/disable email notifications for watchlist changes (required for 'set').

notification_email.description: Override email address for notifications. Omit to use account email.
